method: Fixed independent 4096-trial precision replication of all 15 original persistent disagreements after the first full-game study failed its promotion criteria. Short and Full/matched evaluate both disputed moves; Full/strong evaluates all retained alternatives. 128 blocks of 32 trials; shared dice within position, disjoint seeds across positions and all previous experiments. No pooling or optional stopping. Separate simultaneous 95% Student-t families: 30 cutoff/checker effects, 45 policy-position gaps, and two equally weighted cohort-average effects. Cube3 is not repeated: the previous study did not establish its benefit. Same GNUbg build, normal filters, Jacoby on, beavers off, variance reduction, no rotation and eligible bearoff termination.
